compatibility_scope: declaration-to-template rendering only; hardware model and OS compatibility are not verified

devices.selection_reason: highest deterministic score among admissible templates matching the declared manufacturer, model, OS family, and requested features; physical-device compatibility is unverified

criteria.name: manufacturer_model
criteria.justification: catalog record and template metadata exactly match the declared manufacturer/model

criteria.name: os_family_version
criteria.justification: exact OS family match; catalog OS compatibility is unknown and no OS version was supplied; supported OS-version metadata is absent

criteria.name: requested_features
criteria.justification: all requested features are implemented by the selected template

criteria.name: variables
criteria.justification: all required template variables are present in validated YAML

criteria.name: template_validity
criteria.justification: embedded template parses and its metadata is complete; status is render-only, not hardware-verified

limits: catalog record is partial; manufacturer-specific hardware interfaces and OS versions are not verified
rendering does not prove command acceptance or device state
